violated_contract: A diagnostic reason derived from a protocol status must agree with that status's specified meaning. Android HCI local-host termination (0x16), link-layer response timeout (0x22), and failed connection establishment (0x3e) must not be reported as another-phone pairing, a link-key mismatch, or an Instant Passed error; those claims misdirect users and contaminate support exports and health telemetry.
canonical_prevention: Centralize the production diagnostics and connection-error classifiers, use only causes established by the protocol definition, preserve the original numeric code when the existing reason vocabulary is less specific, and execute specification-backed regression vectors plus adjacent-status controls against those classifiers. Exercise the native-to-Dart pending-readiness error path without triggering a pairing-loss action for local termination.
